_comment: Committed routing registry for W2 (daily-open-items.md) — IDs + flags only, NO credentials. To-dos route by matching the counterparty email domain / name alias to a client, then write into that client's To-Dos data source (titleField); everything else goes to internalBoard (master tracker).

internalBoard.name: TechTower — internal & pipeline (master tracker)
internalBoard._migration_note_2026_07_18: Repointed from the old '📥 Open Items — Daily Tracker' (92836c3b.../45a1139d...) to the current 'To-Do TechTower (current sprint)' board. Schema changed: no more Ref/Source/For/Link/Who fields — now Name/Pillar/Sprint/Priority/Completion Status/Assigned To/Due/Description/Done. Dedup can no longer rely on Ref; match on Name text instead until a stable key is added.

clients.name: Crewline
clients._migration_note_2026_07_18: Old dashboardPageId (38d5b087-b9f3-810b...) was a 'Test New' duplicate page, not the live dashboard. Repointed to Client Dashboard - Crewline. Schema changed: Name/Pillar/Sprint/Priority/Completion Status/Assigned To/Due/Description/Done — no Ref/Source/For/Link.

clients.name: Hassans
clients._migration_note_2026_07_18: CORRECTED back to original: this IS the live board (confirmed by Shaffy, still actively updated). 'Client Dashboard - Hassans' (3005b087.../38d5b087-b9f3-8104...) exists in parallel but is NOT the one in use — don't repeat this mistake. Unlike Crewline, Hassans never migrated off the classic Task/For/Link/Ref/Source/Status schema.
